name: Card Service Type 2 Code
definition: Type of network management service (correspond to the ISO 8583 field 24).

SFDS.name: Disable Store Forward
SFDS.definition: Close communication at application level to stop store and forward process.

ECHO.name: Echo Test
ECHO.definition: Detection whether communication at application level is still active.

SFEN.name: Enable Store Forward
SFEN.definition: Establish communication at application level to start store and forward process.
